errors.text_span: На хоризонталната ос са представени категориите, които са наименования на информационни технологии
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories are on the horizontal axis. The figure is a horizontal bar chart where the categories are on the vertical axis and the numerical values are on the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва стойностите, измерени в конвенционални единици, простиращи се от 0 до 40 с интервали от 10 единици, и са означени с цифри.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the numerical values are on the vertical axis. The figure is a horizontal bar chart where the numerical values are on the horizontal axis and the categories are on the vertical axis.

The description misnames the category with the highest value (36). The correct name shown in the chart is "Електронна система за документооборот" (Electronic system for document management), not "Портал за електронен документооборот" (Portal for electronic document management).
The description mentions that percentage values are shown in parentheses for each bar but completely omits reporting what these values are (e.g., 78.3%, 63%, 26.1%, 50%, 47.8%).
The description uses the word "височина" (height) when referring to the length of the horizontal bars. The word "дължина" (length) would be more precise for a horizontal bar chart.

errors.text_span: които могат да показват някакъв вид пропорция или относителен дял
errors.evidence: Instead of simply reporting the percentage values, the description speculates on their meaning, which constitutes unnecessary interpretation.
